facts.support: Upload/record/submit execute under Runtime::mutex. Reuse is rejected while pending/completion_owner/observers/retiring retain the slot.

Each Run owns its primary command buffers/pools, compute and transfer fences and binary semaphore. Compute pool uses compute queue family; transfer pool uses transfer family. Shared Runtime/Run/Buffer ownership spans this synchronous upload and subsequent pending completion.

The copy buffer is recorded/ended. The handoff buffer is separately Begin/End recorded with no commands; PRIMARY, one-time-submit, reset-capable pool. This is one valid command-buffer object with empty recorded contents, not commandBufferCount=0 or a NULL pCommandBuffers in the source. Both transfer buffers are retained.

Copy signals transfer_ready; only after successful submission does handoff wait on it with ALL_COMMANDS and the run fence. SubmitInfo, wait-stage word, Submission carrier and Run handles remain live throughout synchronous callbacks. Fences are reset only after idle/reuse checks.
Provider invokes callback synchronously under the original optional device-submit mutex followed by native queue lock; no absent host queue serialization is demonstrated.

Eligible storage shared between distinct queue families is created CONCURRENT with both family indices; same-family queues need no family ownership transfer. No missing release/acquire violation is established in this path.
